data.title: Banca Profilo Sees Early Recovery Amid Repositioning
data.description:
An update from Banca Profilo SPA ( (IT:PRO) ) is now available.

Banca Profilo reported early signs of commercial recovery in the third quarter, with Private Banking assets stabilizing and indirect deposits rising by about €59 million from June. However, nine-month consolidated net revenue fell 36.4% year on year to €32.2 million, while net profit was negative at €2.3 million amid the bank’s reorganization and repositioning.

Digital Banking continued to expand, generating €2.8 million in revenue, up 227.3% year on year, while quarterly net interest income rose 22.3% to €6.0 million. Cost reductions, new partnerships including Athora Italia, strengthened management and hiring across key areas supported the integrated wealth-management strategy, alongside robust capital and liquidity ratios.

data.title: Colombia’s Producer Inflation Surges Past Expectations
data.description:
Colombia’s Producer Price Index rose to 4.54% year over year from 2.20% previously, an increase of 2.34 percentage points, or about 106%. The reading signals a sharp acceleration in producer-price inflation.

The result exceeded the 2.90% analyst estimate by 1.64 percentage points, or roughly 57%. The upside surprise is likely to weigh on rate-sensitive stocks and companies exposed to higher input costs, while reinforcing expectations for tighter monetary policy and creating near-term market pressure.

data.title: GTT Reports Purchase of 14,305 Own Shares
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Gaztransport et technigaz ( (FR:GTT) ).

GTT develops membrane containment technologies for liquefied gases, with a primary focus on LNG applications across the maritime and energy sectors. Its engineering solutions support the storage and transport infrastructure underpinning global gas markets.

GTT reported purchases of 14,305 of its own shares on the Euronext Paris market between November 2 and November 5, 2026, at a total average weighted price of €182.91 per share. The disclosure reflects ongoing share-buyback activity and provides transparency on the company’s capital-management transactions, with no direct operational impact specified.

data.title: DeFi Technologies’ Valour Launches Eight Digital Asset ETPs in Sweden
data.description:
DeFi Technologies ( (TSE:DEFI) ) just unveiled an update.

DeFi Technologies is a financial technology company bridging traditional capital markets and decentralized finance, with a focus on digital asset exchange-traded products and related blockchain investment access. Through its subsidiary Valour, the company serves European and international investors seeking exposure to emerging digital asset ecosystems.

On November 5, 2026, Valour launched eight Swedish-krona-denominated digital asset ETPs on Sweden’s Spotlight Stock Market, covering Venice, Canton Network, Raydium, Morpho, Maple Finance, Pump.fun, Dogwifhat and Bonk. Each product carries a 1.9% management fee, expanding Valour’s portfolio beyond 100 ETPs and broadening regulated market access to assets spanning artificial intelligence, institutional blockchain infrastructure, decentralized finance and community-driven tokens.

data.title: Yataş Reports Higher Revenue Amid Financing and Liquidity Pressure
data.description:
Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:YATAS) ) has shared an update.

Yataş reported nine-month revenue of TL 20.8 billion, up from TL 20.0 billion a year earlier, while operating profit reached TL 773.1 million. Finance costs of TL 1.93 billion outweighed finance income and contributed to a pretax loss, although tax income helped produce net profit of TL 240.8 million.

Total assets and liabilities declined from year-end 2025 levels, while equity rose to TL 13.5 billion. Operating activities generated TL 414.7 million in cash, but investment and financing outflows reduced cash and equivalents to TL 681.8 million, highlighting pressure on liquidity despite continued operating cash generation.
